content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for MANIT Bhopal Project Assistant Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 13-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the MANIT Bhopal Project Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the MANIT Bhopal Project Assistant position is 13th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates should possess a B.Tech in Civil Engineering with a preference for 70% marks, and an M.Tech in Water and Environment Engineering is desirable.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 27,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the MANIT Bhopal Project Assistant job?
faq.answer: Applications need to be sent via email. Ensure you attach all required documents and send the email before the deadline.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for this role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Assistant position will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q7. How many vacancies are available for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Assistant position at MANIT Bhopal.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: This is a contract-based job opportunity.

faq.question: Q9. Where is MANIT Bhopal located?
faq.answer: MANIT Bhopal is located in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh.
